Keswick Systems, the software company based in Wexbury, announced this week that it will open a new regional service center aimed at supporting its rapidly growing customer base throughout the Hadleigh market. --[1]--.
The facility will occupy several floors of the Trelane Complex in Tarnwick, roughly an hour's drive south of the company's main offices, and will handle technical support and account services for the entire region. --[2]--. "Placing a team closer to our clients allows us to respond to their needs far more quickly," said Gerald Thornbury, the company's chief operations officer, who has overseen the project since it began.
According to the company, the center is expected to create about sixty new positions during its first year of operation. --[3]--. Hiring will proceed in stages, with the first group of employees starting during the first quarter of next year and additional staff added by the third quarter. Renovation work at the building is expected to be finished shortly before the first employees arrive. --[4]--.

Whether you are planning a family dinner or a large office party, Oakmere Bakery has a cake to suit the occasion. Our cakes come in three sizes, which are set out in the table below.
Size	Serves up to	Top	Price
Small	Eight people	Plain top only	$22
Medium	Sixteen people	Fruit or plain top	$38
Large	Thirty people	Any design, including a written greeting	$60
Ordering
To order, choose your shop and your pickup day at the counter and pay half the price, and the rest is due when you pick the cake up. Because large cakes are baked at only some of our shops, please see our shop list before ordering one, and allow five days' notice for any large cake. To learn more, come in and talk to the staff at any of our four shops.

Order reference: CK-3187
March 12
Dear Mr. Yates,
Thank you for your order for a medium cake for the weekend of March 28.
You placed that order at our Priory Street shop, which is having its ovens repaired during the last week of March. No baking will be done there that week.
Every medium cake for that weekend has already been promised to other customers, so we will bake you a large cake instead. You will still pay only the price of the medium size.
Your cake will be ready at the shop that bakes large cakes and opens at eight o'clock on weekends. Please pick it up before noon, as any cake left at closing time is sold in the shop.
Monica Ibarra
Orders Manager
Order changes can be made only at our Eastcote shop, where our order records are kept.
